pages.text: Leapkelp are the underwater variant of Leapleaf. They can be created by submerging a Leapleaf underwater, or summoned underwater using a Leaping Focus.
Build underwater, then right click the center Overgrown Roots with an Animation Core.
The creature can be healed by right-clicking on them with Bone Meals, or the summoner wearing Abyss Robe can also provide healing.
